say:2:1330330002:1.text: During the festival, a tourist left through the back door and ran into a beast.
say:2:1330330002:1.source_cn: 祭典的时候有一位游客从后门离开旅店，结果遇到了野兽。
say:2:1330330002:1.male: During the festival, a tourist left through the back door and ran into a beast.
say:2:1330330002:1.female: During the festival, a tourist left through the back door and ran into a beast.

say:3:1330330003:1.text: So Boss had me put up a sign to stop guests from leaving the inn unnecessarily.
say:3:1330330003:1.source_cn: 所以老板娘让我立个告示，让那些客人不要随意离开旅店。
say:3:1330330003:1.male: So Boss had me put up a sign to stop guests from leaving the inn unnecessarily.
say:3:1330330003:1.female: So Boss had me put up a sign to stop guests from leaving the inn unnecessarily.
